result.brief: 提出 FORCE 视频世界模型，用槽注意力从冻结自监督特征提取物体，并以成对关系潜变量显式建模交互，支持关系删除、替换、迁移与引入的反事实编辑，并指出感知精度是瓶颈。
result.reason: Object-centric video world model with explicit per-pair relation latents enabling counterfactual editing; slot attention over frozen self-supervised features ties to representation learning.
